overlap.note: pixel: keyed by (block, i, j); input: keyed by the six observed values, which merges the repeats of one clean AIA input across solver targets

training_sample.feature: log10(observed DN/s) per channel, standardised by the sample's mean and std

purpose: Census of the pixels on which the large models blow up; an association study

definitions.valid: finite solver DEM (18 bins) and finite observations; per model also a finite prediction
definitions.sse: sum over the 18 bins of (prediction - solver)^2 per pixel
definitions.clamp: an observed channel at or below 0.001 DN/s (the deconvolution positivity clamp)
definitions.band: max over channels of observed / Bright threshold, as in aia_fit_by_brightness.py
definitions.worst_sets: top-k pixels by SSE; distinct inputs merge repeats of one clean AIA input
definitions.nn_distance: Euclidean distance in standardised log10-observation space to the nearest pixel of the stratified training sample (d1) and the mean over the 10 nearest (d10)
definitions.multipeaked: zero-padded curve, >= 2 interior peaks with prominence >= 0.15 x curve max
